name: Apartament Floreasca
address: Str. Exemplu 12, et. 3, ap. 14, Sector 1, București. The building entrance is the blue door next to the pharmacy.

stay.late_check_out: sometimes possible until 13:00 — ask the host the evening before
stay.luggage: no storage after check-out, but the host can sometimes hold bags for a few hours if asked in advance

access.building_entry: interphone code 14# then wait for the buzz, or ring 14
access.door_code: key box on the left of the door, code 4471, put the key back in the box when you leave

appliances.name: Induction hob
appliances.instructions: Touch the power symbol bottom-left for two seconds. Then tap a zone and use + / – for heat. It only works with the pans in the cupboard under the sink; the glass ones won't heat. It switches itself off if you leave a zone on with no pan.

appliances.name: Washing machine
appliances.instructions: Detergent is in the drawer above it. Use the 'Mix 40°' program, it takes about one hour. Don't use the 90° program, it's very loud for the neighbours.

appliances.name: Hot water
appliances.instructions: There is a boiler inside the hallway cupboard and you turn the lever and push the button to turn it on

appliances.name: Air conditioning
appliances.instructions: Remote is on the hallway shelf. Press ON, the snowflake for cooling, sun for heating. Please switch it off when you go out.

house_rules: Quiet hours 22:00–08:00 — the building is mostly families.
No smoking inside. The balcony is fine.
No parties or extra overnight guests beyond the booking.
Please take shoes off at the door.
waste: Bins are in the yard behind the building, through the door at the end of the ground-floor corridor. Blue for paper and plastic, black for everything else. Glass goes in the green bin on the street corner.
parking: Free street parking on Str. Exemplu after 18:00 and all day Sunday. On weekdays 08:00–18:00 it's paid via the Amparcare app, about 5 lei per hour. Don't park in front of the pharmacy — they call the tow truck.
transport: Metro: Aurel Vlaicu station is an 8-minute walk. Line M2 goes straight to Piața Unirii and Universitate.
Airport: Bus 100 from Piața Charles de Gaulle runs every 15 minutes, about 40 minutes to Otopeni. Or Bolt / Uber, around 60–80 lei.
Taxis: use Bolt or Uber. Avoid hailing on the street near the airport.

neighborhood.name: Origo
neighborhood.note: best coffee nearby, busy on weekend mornings

neighborhood.name: Caru' cu Bere
neighborhood.note: classic Romanian food in the old town, touristy but good; book ahead on weekends

faq.a: Top shelf of the bathroom cupboard.
Yes, in the wardrobe in the bedroom, with the ironing board.

faq.q: Can I get a taxi to the airport at 5am?
faq.a: Bolt works at that hour. Book it 15 minutes before; pickups are quick in Floreasca.
